title: AI+ International Cooperation Initiative (MFA, Sept 24, 2025)
notes: MFA (primary/official), 2025-09-24, full text. AI+ International Cooperation Initiative proposed at high-level meeting on Global Development Initiative (2025-09-23). AI 'inherently empowering'; UN 2030 Agenda; community with shared future. Calls on all countries to carry out AI+ campaigns per national conditions. 5 campaigns: AI+ public well-being (healthcare/education), AI+ technological advancement, AI+ industrial application, AI+ cultural prosperity, AI+ talents cultivation (joint AI education resources, talent exchanges).
